question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

If I ______ you, I would take the feedback positively.
solution:
The correct answer is **'were'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence expresses the **subjunctive mood. **
 
• **The subjunctive mood expresses a hypothetical situation, one that has not come to pass but might come to pass.**
